products.name: Clip-in Hair Extensions Set
products.shortDesc: 8-piece double-drawn Remy clip-in set — no commitment, full volume in minutes.
products.longDesc: Our signature 8-piece clip-in set in 100% Remy human hair. Silicone-lined wefts that place and remove yourself in minutes, colour-matched to your natural hair. Available in lengths 14–24 inches.

products.name: Tape-in Extensions
products.shortDesc: Feather-thin panels at the root — invisible under fine hair.
products.longDesc: Ultra-flat panels sandwiched at the root with medical-grade adhesive. Repositioned as your hair grows out. Ideal for fine to medium hair.

products.name: Hand-tied Weft
products.shortDesc: Ultra-flat rows sewn to a beaded row — seamless all-over thickness.
products.longDesc: Rows of hand-tied hair sewn onto a beaded foundation. The stylist's favourite for seamless density from crown to tip. Bespoke fitting per client.

products.name: Halo Hair Extension
products.shortDesc: One weft on an invisible wire — on and off in seconds. Gentlest of all.
products.longDesc: A single weft on a fine transparent wire that sits under the crown. No glue, no clips, no tension. Perfect for daily volume without commitment.

products.name: Keratin I-tip Bonds
products.shortDesc: Individual strands bonded one by one — the most natural movement and parting.
products.longDesc: 150–200 individual Remy strands bonded to your natural hair with keratin. The longest-wearing method with the most natural fall, parting, and movement.
